cgu.objetText: Tiwtilin-a timatutin n useqdec (CGU) ttnaḍament anekcum d useqdec n tɣerɣert Tala DZ (taladz.com), syin d asawen « Tiɣerɣert ». Mi ara d-terneḍ amiḍan neɣ ara tesqedceḍ Tiɣerɣert, ad tqebleḍ war tilas tiwtilin-a CGU akked Tsertit n tbaḍnit.
cgu.accesText: Anekcum ɣer Tɣerɣert d baṭel i yinerzafen. Asnulfu n umiḍan d baṭel, yeldi i yimdanen yesɛan ma drus 13 iseggasen. Imiḍanen imsaduren ttwaseḥqaqen sɣur tarbaɛt-nneɣ n usenqed. Kečč i yerfden tabaḍnit n yisulay-ik n tuqqna.
cgu.contenuText: Ad teǧǧeḍ taɣara tamseknant n yigburen-ik. Mi ara d-tsuffɣeḍ ɣef Tɣerɣert, ad tefkeḍ i Tala DZ turagt ur nelli d tamagdayt, d tilellit, akken ad d-teskan, ad tebḍu, ad tessekker igburen-ik deg tɣerɣert. Agbur yettwasufɣen ilaq ad yeqqader isaḍuf yellan, izerfan n umeskar, ur ilaq ad yesɛu awal n tukksa n leqder, n usemyezzi neɣ ur nettusireg ara. Nḥerrez azref n usenqed neɣ n tukksa n yal agbur ur nwulem ara.
cgu.responsabiliteText: Tala DZ tesseqdac akk afud-is i wakken Tiɣerɣert ad tili d tawjidt, d taɣellsant, war ma tettḍemmen tikli ur nettḥbis ara. Ur nettili d imsulya ɣef yigburen i d-suffɣen yiseqdacen. Ma yella umennuɣ, d azref azzayri i yettwasnasen.
cgu.modificationText: Nezmer ad nbeddel tiwtilin-a CGU melmi i nebɣa. Iseqdacen ad ttwalɣen s yilɣa ɣef Tɣerɣert. Aseqdec deffir usnifel yettwaḥseb d aqbal n twtilin timaynutin.

privacy.responsableText: Amsul ɣef usesfer n yisefka udmawanen d Tala DZ, ara tafeḍ deg tansa taladz.com. I yal asteqsi ɣef ummesten n yisefka-ik, tzemreḍ ad aɣ-tnermseḍ deg tansa: contact@taladz.com.

privacy.donneesIdentite: Isefka n tmagit: isem, isem amezwaru, tansa n yimayl (ttwasran deg ujerred)
privacy.donneesOptionnelles: Isefka afrayanen: azemz n tlalit, tuzzuft, tiliɣri, tansa, tawlaft n umaɣnu, tameddurt
privacy.donneesPro: Isefka imsaduren (ma yella): takebbanit, tizriyin, iselkinen, asmel web
privacy.donneesNavigation: Isefka n tunigin: tansa IP (war isem), isebtar yettwakesmen, anaw n yibenk
privacy.pasDeVente: Talɣut-ik tudmawant werǧin ad tettwazenz i wiyaḍ.

privacy.soustraitantsIntro: I wakken ad teddu Tɣerɣert, nesseqdac imeẓla-a:
privacy.soustraitantCloudinary: Cloudinary — asneftaɣ n tugniwin d yimidyaten i d-tessuffuɣeḍ (iqeddacen beṛṛa n Lezzayer)
privacy.soustraitantEmail: Asaǧǧaw n tuzna n yimaylen (SMTP) — imaylen n umyezzi d tebrat n yisallen (tansa-ik n yimayl)

privacy.soustraitantsPas: Ulac isefka udmawanen ara yettwazzenzen, ara yettwakerrayen neɣ ara yettwafken i yiswan n tnezzut. Tisefsiyin d tignitin ttwasneftaɣent sɣur Tɣerɣert s yiman-is.
privacy.cookiesText: Tiɣerɣert tesseqdac kan inagan n tuqqna (cookies) ilaqen s tidet i tikli (asesteb, asmenyif n tutlayt, taɣellist CSRF). Ulac inagan n udellel neɣ n uḍfar n wiyaḍ i yettwasqedcen.
privacy.reclamationText: Ma twalaḍ belli asesfer n yisefka-ik ur yeqqader ara asaḍuf, tzemreḍ ad tazneḍ acetki ɣer tnabaḍt n ummesten n yisefka n tmurt-ik (deg Fransa: CNIL — cnil.fr, di Lezzayer: ANPDP).

mentions.editeurText: Tala DZ — Tiɣerɣert n uttekki i usazal n tdelsa tazzayrit.
mentions.hebergeurText: Tiɣerɣert tettwasneftaɣ ɣef uqeddac VPS uslig yettwaḥerzen (HTTPS, aselkin Let's Encrypt).
mentions.dpoText: I yal asteqsi ɣef ummesten n yisefka-ik udmawanen, tzemreḍ ad tnermseḍ amagi-nneɣ n ummesten n yisefka deg tansa: contact@taladz.com.

apropos.ressourcesText: Tala DZ tefka-d tiɣbula i wakken ad tissineḍ, ad tessekreḍ tadelsa tazzayrit: tidyanin, ixeddimen, taẓuri tameɣradt, ismal n tdelsa d wayen-nniḍen.
